study_name.notes: No canonical study identifier (e.g., EinsteinA_YYYY format) is provided in the paper.

target_condition.evidence_quote: Methotrexate (MTX), a first-line rheumatoid arthritis (RA) treatment; DSS as inflammatory trigger
target_condition.notes: Primary condition is RA; inflammatory bowel disease model used in mice (DSS colitis).

body_site.evidence_quote: stool sample collected; Daily stool samples and endpoint samples from cecum and colon
body_site.notes: Primary biospecimen is fecal/stool samples from human donors and patients.

sequencing_platform.evidence_quote: The V4 hypervariable region of bacterial 16S ribosomal RNA (rRNA) was performed using a MiSeq Illumina platform
sequencing_platform.section: Methods — NYU Human RA patient samples acquisition
sequencing_platform.notes: 16S rRNA sequencing was performed on MiSeq; shotgun metagenomic sequencing on NovaSeq also conducted.

ncbi_accession.evidence_quote: All sequencing data generated in the preparation of this manuscript has been deposited in NCBI's Sequence Read Archive (SRA), under Bioproject ID PRJNA656577.

country.evidence_quote: Consecutive patients from the New York University Langone Medical Center's rheumatology clinics
country.section: Methods — NYU Human RA patient samples acquisition
country.notes: Study used samples from New York University, indicating United States location.

dna_extraction_kit.evidence_quote: DNA was extracted from human fecal samples using the MoBio Powersoil DNA extraction kit
dna_extraction_kit.section: Methods — NYU Human RA patient samples acquisition
dna_extraction_kit.notes: MoBio PowerSoil kit used for human RA patient samples; ZymoBIOMICS used for mouse samples.

antibiotics_exclusion_period.evidence_quote: recent (<3 months prior) use of any antibiotic therapy

antibiotics_exclusion_period_unit.evidence_quote: recent (<3 months prior) use of any antibiotic therapy

sex.notes: Sex/gender not reported for individual human RA patient samples in aggregate data; gnotobiotic mouse studies used females.

age.notes: Age not reported for individual human RA patients in the provided text; only 'age 18 years or older' mentioned as inclusion.

ancestry.notes: Ancestry not reported in provided sections.

control.notes: Paper describes RA patients and gnotobiotic mice colonized with human microbiota; no traditional healthy control samples are clearly assigned per-sample.

age_years.notes: Specific age in years not reported for individual human donors or patient cohorts

disease.evidence_quote: Consecutive patients from the New York University Langone Medical Center's rheumatology clinics screened for the presence of RA

disease_response_pfs_month.notes: PFS follow-up not applicable to RA study

feces_phenotype.notes: Stool samples were analyzed for microbiota composition, richness, and community structure changes

fmt_role.section: RESULTS — The post-treatment microbiome decreases host immune activation
fmt_role.notes: Human donors provided stool for FMT into germ-free mice; mice served as recipients

neonatal_preterm_birth.notes: Preterm birth status not applicable; study involves adult participants

tumor_staging_tnm.notes: TNM tumor staging not applicable; study involves rheumatoid arthritis not cancer

biomarker_unit.notes: Units inferred from context of measurements; various measurement types used across different biomarkers.

value: log2 fold changes ≥20 in some ASVs
biomarker_value.evidence_quote: fold change relative to pre-MTX recipients, 36/45 (80%) isolates exhibited either full growth inhibition
biomarker_value.notes: Biomarker values reported as fold changes, percentages, and count data depending on measurement type.

disease_response_os.notes: This is a mechanistic study of MTX effects on microbiota, not a survival study. OS not measured.

disease_response_os_unit.notes: Not applicable; OS not measured in this study.

ecog_performance_status.notes: ECOG performance status not reported in this study.

feces_phenotype_value.evidence_quote: High-dose MTX altered 14 bacterial genera and 81 amplicon sequence variants (ASVs) spanning multiple phyla
feces_phenotype_value.notes: Fecal microbiota phenotypes reported as changes in taxa abundance and community composition in response to MTX treatment.

tumor_size_measurement.notes: Not applicable; this study focuses on RA and microbiota, not tumor measurements.

tumor_size_residual_measurement.notes: Not applicable; this study focuses on RA and microbiota, not tumor measurements.

value: Study includes gnotobiotic mouse experiments with human stool colonization

RA patients treated with standard-dose oral MTX

Ex vivo incubation of stool samples at 100 μg/ml MTX
DSS-induced colitis used as inflammatory trigger in mice
Flow cytometry used to assess immune cell populations

Gnotobiotic mouse experiments used humanized microbiota from donors but mice themselves are not the primary sample units; donor information is reported instead.
Body_site for mice experiments includes cecum and colon (not just feces); only feces is listed as the primary body_site enum value, though cecal and colon contents were also analyzed.
Batch 1 returned granularity='subgroup_level', differs from batch 0 ('sample_level'); kept batch 0.

MTX responder status defined as DAS28 improvement ≥1.8; only 8 of 23 patients classified as responders
